newsitem.title: INDIA: Northeast India rebels kill three soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Northeast India rebels kill three soldiers.

text.p: Separatist tribal guerrillas shot dead three paramilitary personnel and injured nine in northeastern India on Wednesday, police said.
"The rebels of National Liberation Front of Tripura today gunned down three paramilitary soldiers in north Tripura," state home (interior) minister Samar Chaudhury told Reuters.
Nine paramilitary soldiers were critically wounded in the attack that took place at Natum Bari in north Tripura, some 130 km (80 miles) from state capital Agartala, state police said.
The state government asked army and paramilitary to search the area.
The National Liberation Front of Tripura is an outlawed guerrilla group that has been fighting for a separate homeland since 1989.
